in_marathi.name: Karansinh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karansinh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Karansinh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kara' which means 'action' or 'doer' and 'Sinh' which means 'lion'. This name is believed to represent Krishna, who is often depicted as the 'Lord of the Universe' and the 'Divine Protector'. The name Karansinh is a symbol of power, courage, and strength.
